study: Fornasaro et al. large-scale European interlaboratory study
relevance_to_nato: Establishes that SERS instrument/substrate reproducibility is itself a central scientific problem
important_limit_or_difference: Designed reference analyte and standardized study; NATO archive is heterogeneous field data

study: Li et al. Raman spectrum matching with contrastive representation learning
relevance_to_nato: Supports contrastive matching when class examples are scarce
important_limit_or_difference: NATO has repeated physical masters but only seven confounded target classes

study: Balytskyi et al. Raman spectroscopy in open-world settings
domain_structure: 40 chemical classes split into known ignored and unseen
relevance_to_nato: Provides a Raman-specific open-set baseline and unknown-rejection framing
important_limit_or_difference: NATO has only seven classes and unknown-class splits are confounded with station

study: Park et al. inter-laboratory variation minimization
domain_structure: multiple laboratories measuring the same analyte
relevance_to_nato: Closest precedent for learning invariance across SERS acquisition domains
important_limit_or_difference: Regression and controlled lab setting; NATO is classification with instruments sensors and field stations

study: Integration of SERS and machine learning for coffee classification
relevance_to_nato: Directly recognizes substrate enhancement variability as a classification nuisance
important_limit_or_difference: Food-mixture task and less explicit paired instrument-transfer structure

study: Blake et al. system transferability of Raman tissue classification
domain_structure: three same-make spectrometers at three centres
relevance_to_nato: Strong evaluation precedent: split at independent sample and explicitly test system transfer
important_limit_or_difference: Used tightly harmonized same-make instruments and over 560000 spectra; NATO has ten heterogeneous instruments and 69 masters

study: Wang et al. transfer contrastive learning for skin cancer tissue classification
domain_structure: different Raman equipment and related source tasks
relevance_to_nato: Supports external or cross-equipment pretraining rather than training a large CNN from scratch
important_limit_or_difference: Biomedical tissue domains differ from SERS substrates and field chemicals

study: Yao et al. adversarial contrastive domain-generative learning
task: bacterial identification under unseen acquisition conditions
method: adversarial domain generation plus contrastive learning
relevance_to_nato: Direct methodological candidate for acquisition-domain robustness
important_limit_or_difference: Preprint and denoising claims are not directly verifiable without clean paired NATO targets

study: Song et al. LoRA calibration transfer
domain_structure: multiple spectrometers and three mixture/oil datasets
relevance_to_nato: Useful comparator if a few labeled calibration samples from a new instrument are allowed
important_limit_or_difference: Addresses supervised model adaptation rather than zero-shot unseen-instrument generalization

study: Deep cross-device SERS standardization for bacterial recognition
domain_structure: four portable devices plus laboratory reference
relevance_to_nato: Shows direct cross-device SERS standardization is an active publication direction
important_limit_or_difference: Requires a high-fidelity reference domain and paired target spectra that NATO does not clearly provide

study: Wang et al. open-set recognition using GASF
method: SE-ResUNet1D reconstruction plus GASF and MSP rejection
relevance_to_nato: Most current direct SERS open-set comparator
important_limit_or_difference: NATO class count is much smaller and chemical unknowns are entangled with field station

study: Hwang et al. robust SERS preprocessing and peak extraction preprint
task: classification across substrate dye mordant and aging factors
relevance_to_nato: Highly relevant to testing scale-selective peak extraction against substrate variation
important_limit_or_difference: Recent preprint; method should be treated as exploratory until peer-reviewed and independently reproduced
